name: Matteo DeSimone
title: Analytics Engineer & Software Engineer
bio: I am a full-stack software engineer who excels at building scalable and efficient web applications. I have experience in a variety of technologies and have worked on projects ranging from small marketing and e-commerce sites to large enterprise applications. Recently I have been focusing on data science and analytics engineering, and I am passionate about using data to drive business decisions. I am completing my Bachelor's of Science in Analytics and have focused on machine learning and data engineering pipelines. I am looking to transition into a role where I can combine my software engineering and data skills to solve complex problems.
